airframe.name: CAP 580
airframe.blurb: A 1702 mm Extreme Flight CAP 580 on 6S, balsa and carbon, with 2.6 times its weight in thrust on a measured T-Motor bench table. It hovers, torque rolls, harriers and knife edges like the Extra, but at twice the weight it carries its speed through every figure: precise on the lines, heavy in the snap.

cg.source: Extreme Flight's data sheet, "Center of wing tube for maiden, sport and precision flight", and the 67 in line's build guide, "at the former immediately behind the wing tube"; the tube's station FITTED at 130 mm (docs/CAP580-STAGE1.md), the former about 20 mm behind it; https://extremeflightrc.com/cdn/shop/files/DATASHEET_67_CAP_ecb0e58c-fdbf-409f-85e7-0af3bab79c00.pdf

throws.source: Extreme Flight's data sheet, in degrees: high aileron 38 up 34 down (36 each way), elevator 50, rudder 50 to 55 (52.5); low aileron 15 to 20, elevator 10 to 12, rudder 20 (docs/CAP580-STAGE1.md); https://extremeflightrc.com/cdn/shop/files/DATASHEET_67_CAP_ecb0e58c-fdbf-409f-85e7-0af3bab79c00.pdf; https://extremeflightrc.com/cdn/shop/files/67_Extra260_ARF_Build_guide.pdf

tunes.name: Manual
tunes.note: No flight controller. The sticks are the ailerons, the elevator and the rudder at Extreme Flight's 3D rates. Heavier and faster than the Extra: it carries its speed through a figure and wants a firmer hand. Hang it on the prop and the torque rolls it left unless you hold it on the ailerons.

tunes.name: AS3X
tunes.note: A Spektrum AR637T receiver fitted by the builder, its AS3X on: the sticks are the surfaces at the 3D rates; centred, the gyro holds the attitude you left it in, against the gusts and the torque's kicks; held, it turns at the rate you ask; past 40 percent stick it lets go, so full stick is full throw. Nothing levels it and nothing caps a rate.

tunes.name: SAFE Select
tunes.note: The same receiver with SAFE Select on: roll stick asks for a bank up to 60 degrees, pitch stick for a pitch up to 30, centred sticks fly level. It cannot hover or tumble: switch to Manual or AS3X for 3D.
